question: 2025年中，商品销售金额高于全国地区平均销售金额、且订单笔数也高于全国地区平均订单笔数的区域有哪些？（请给出地区、销售额与订单数）
gold_sql: SELECT o.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region HAVING SUM(oi.subtotal) > (SELECT AVG(v.revenue) FROM (SELECT region, SUM(oi2.subtotal) AS revenue FROM orders o2 JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi2.order_id = o2.id WHERE o2.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o2.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o2.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o2.region) v) AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) > (SELECT AVG(w.orders) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o3.id) AS orders FROM orders o3 JOIN order_items oi3 ON oi3.order_id = o3.id WHERE o3.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o3.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o3.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o3.region) w) ORDER BY revenue DESC, o.region
